detail: Stata's nlswork, filed as stata_nlswork:nlswork.dta: ETL/wages_etl.R keeps 15 covariates, ln_wage and idcode, drops every row with a missing value (28013 rows remain) and dummy-codes year, ind_code, occ_code and race. Sigrist 2023 (Table 1 Wages, run_experiments.R) fits ln_wage ~ covariates + I(age^2) + I(ttl_exp^2) + I(tenure^2) + (1 | idcode) + (0 + t | idcode) + (0 + I(t^2) | idcode), t = year - 78.

wide: one row per feasible kernel parameter combination, its four repeated runs as the columns Run1 (ms) to Run4 (ms) (UCI page: "For each tested combination, 4 runs were performed"). LMMNN (r_scripts/lme4_on_datasets/lme4_sgemm.R, notebooks/categorical/sgemm.ipynb) stacks the runs and fits log(t) ~ the 14 parameters + (1 | z0), z0 the row index.

LMMNN's unit is a location cell, Latitude and Longitude rounded to 0.1 degree (r_scripts/ETL/radiation_etl.R: Japan, 2017, cpm only, 1.2K cells, a 10% sample per cell; Table 10 Radiation, a Gaussian process over the cells, response log Value), a derived key no column holds; the raw coordinates of moving bGeigie readings rarely repeat, and Device ID and Loader ID are undocumented.
